skill.name: webask-quiz-distribution
skill.description: Готовит опрос WebAsk к раздаче: адрес ссылки, QR-код, пароли для закрытого доступа, метки источников и печатная версия. Применяется, когда человек спрашивает, как разослать опрос, где взять ссылку или как отличить, из какого канала пришли ответы.
skill.summary: Prepare WebAsk survey links, source labels, QR codes, access passwords, and printable exports.
skill.author: webaskio

content.value_statement: Survey responses become difficult to attribute when every channel shares an unlabelled link. This skill guides WebAsk distribution with source labels, QR codes, access passwords, and printable versions.
actual_capabilities: Guides survey URL configuration through set_quiz_link, with warnings before changing an address already shared.
Plans channel-specific source labels and retrieves recorded label values through get_answer_extra_field_values.
Uses manage_quiz_qr_code for QR codes with format, size, color, and logo options.
Uses manage_quiz_passwords for restricted access, with batches limited to 50 passwords.
Uses export_quiz_print for PDF, Word, HTML, or text versions of a survey.
Checks publication status before distribution and requires permission before publishing.
limitations: Requires access to the corresponding WebAsk MCP tools; this package contains instructions, not their implementations.
Does not document sending email campaigns, posting messages, or distributing printed materials automatically.
Source labels cannot be added retrospectively to responses collected without them.
Unpublished surveys cannot open through shared links, and changing an existing survey address breaks previously distributed links.

use_cases.title: Track campaign response sources
use_cases.description: Prepare separate labelled links for email, social media, and website banners before a survey campaign starts.

use_cases.title: Collect event feedback
use_cases.description: Prepare a branded QR code for venue signs and verify its destination before printing.

use_cases.title: Distribute restricted questionnaires
use_cases.description: Prepare group-specific access passwords and a printable questionnaire for review before distribution.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a survey link
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me share WebAsk survey [survey name]. Check whether it is published and ask before changing its address or publication status.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: prepare a survey for sharing.

prompt_templates.title: Label distribution channels
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare source-labelled links for WebAsk survey [survey name] for email, social media, and our website banner. Keep the existing survey address.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: distinguish responses from multiple channels.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare an offline QR code
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a QR code for WebAsk survey [survey name] for a reception sign. Use [size], [color], and [logo], and verify the destination before printing.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate restricted distribution
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare restricted distribution for WebAsk survey [survey name] across [channels] for 120 participants. Plan source labels and password batches of at most 50. Export a PDF for review, preserve existing links, and ask before publishing.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: combine channel tracking, restricted access, and document review.

output_examples.input: Plan source labels for our email campaign, social channel, website banner, and reception QR code.
output: Proposed source labels: email-campaign, social-channel, website-banner, and reception-qr.
Use one labelled survey link per channel and encode the reception link in the QR code.
Check publication status and scan the QR code before distribution.
Review recorded source label values after responses arrive.

output_examples.input: Plan restricted access for 120 participants and a printable review copy.
output: Assign passwords to the intended participant groups.
Prepare a PDF export for questionnaire review.
Confirm permission before publishing the survey and preserve any address already shared.

best_practices: Choose descriptive source labels for every channel before sharing any survey links.
Verify publication status and scan each QR code before producing printed materials.
Confirm access requirements, preserve shared addresses, and request explicit permission before publishing.
anti_patterns: Sharing an unlabelled link everywhere and expecting reliable channel attribution afterward.
Changing a distributed survey address without warning that existing links will stop working.
Requesting more than 50 passwords in one batch instead of splitting the request.

faq.question: Does this skill send survey invitations?
faq.answer: It prepares distribution materials and access settings. The documented tools do not send email campaigns or post invitations.

faq.question: What does the skill need to perform actions?
faq.answer: It needs access to the five corresponding WebAsk MCP tools. The package declares these dependencies but does not implement them.

faq.question: Can source labels be added after responses arrive?
faq.answer: The instructions state that labels cannot be applied retrospectively. Configure channel labels before distributing links.

faq.question: Can I customize the QR code?
faq.answer: The documented QR tool supports format, size, color, and a central logo. Verify the destination before printing.

faq.question: How many passwords can be prepared at once?
faq.answer: The instructions limit each batch to 50 passwords. Larger groups require multiple batches.

faq.question: Which printable formats are supported?
faq.answer: The documented export tool provides PDF, Word, HTML, and plain text versions.
